text:
Arcanaut Studios is a video game company founded in July 2025 by Casey Hudson. On December 11, it was announced at The Game Awards 2025 that Arcanaut Studios would develop Star Wars: Fate of the Old Republic, a singleplayer action role-playing game in collaboration with Lucasfilm Games.

On March 8, 2026, Pascal Blanché announced on social media that he was joining the studio as its Art Director, to work on Fate of the Old Republic.
